title: Pipeline events system table is in Beta
body:
The `pipeline_events` system table is in [Beta](/aws/en/release-notes/release-types). This table records [Lakeflow pipelines](/aws/en/ldp) event log entries for pipelines in your account, capturing lifecycle transitions, flow progress, data quality metrics, errors, and other operational data across all pipelines and workspaces in a region. Use it to query historical pipeline activity, build alerts on pipeline failures, and correlate pipeline behavior with other Lakeflow system tables.

See [Pipeline events system table reference](/aws/en/admin/system-tables/pipeline-events).
